units.source_text: 在成生海角的寺庙附近，没有合适的中学。

en.t: Near the temple at Cape Nariu, there was no suitable middle school.

units.source_text: 不久，我便离开双亲膝下，寄养在老家的叔父家中，从这里徒步走读于东舞鹤中学。

en.t: Before long, I left my parents' care and boarded at my uncle's house in my hometown, walking from there to attend East Maizuru Middle School.
